mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) and renal dysfunction that potentiate candesartan's hypotensive and hyperkalemic effects, increasing risk of symptomatic hypotension and arrhythmias.
action: Monitor blood pressure, serum electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and renal function closely; consider candesartan dose reduction or alternative antihypertensive; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation during foscarnet therapy.
